استدرجن (form X)
# اِسْتَدْرَجْنَ (istadrajna) /is.tad.rad͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# اُسْتُدْرِجْنَ (ustudrijna) /us.tud.rid͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# اِسْتَدْرِجْنَ (istadrijna) /is.tad.rid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
